import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { mountAdvancedProfile } from '../templates/profile/advanced/mount.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const result = await mountAdvancedProfile(element, { i18n, inheritAppearance: true }, onError);
	return result;
}

import { computed } from 'vue';
import type { AriaAttributes } from 'vue';

// Vue透传的标准ARIA与本预览专用DOM事件；不放宽未知业务属性或事件。
declare module 'vue' {
	interface ComponentCustomProps {
		'aria-label'?: string;
		'aria-current'?: AriaAttributes['aria-current'];
	}
	interface HTMLAttributes {
		onAsamPreviewTheme?: (event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) => void;
	}
}

/** 公共输入允许清空或多种标量，页面模型只接收自己声明的合法值。 */
export function choiceModel<Value extends string | number>(
	read: () => Value,
	write: (value: Value) => void,
	choices: readonly Value[]
) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (choices.some((choice) => Object.is(choice, value))) write(value as Value);
		}
	});
}
export function booleanModel(read: () => boolean, write: (value: boolean) => void) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (typeof value === 'boolean') write(value);
		}
	});
}
export function textModel(read: () => string, write: (value: string) => void) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (typeof value === 'string') write(value);
		}
	});
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();

import { computed, useId } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { FlowData, FlowTab } from './Types.js';
const props = defineProps<{
	data?: FlowData;
	loading: boolean;
	error: string;
	tab: FlowTab;
	disabled: boolean;
}>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ select: [tab: string]; retry: [] }>();
const uid = useId();
function tabAttributes(
	id: string
): Pick<HTMLAttributes, 'id' | 'role' | 'aria-selected' | 'aria-controls' | 'tabindex'> {
	return {
		id: `${uid}-${id}-tab`,
		role: 'tab',
		'aria-selected': props.tab === id,
		'aria-controls': `${uid}-${id}`,
		tabindex: props.tab === id ? 0 : -1
	};
}
const tabs = computed(() => [
	{ id: 'overview', label: i18n.t('app.templates.details.overview') },
	{ id: 'history', label: i18n.t('app.templates.details.flowHistory') },
	{ id: 'related', label: i18n.t('app.templates.details.relatedInformation') }
]);
const stepLabels = computed(() => ({
	done: i18n.t('app.templates.details.complete'),
	current: i18n.t('app.templates.details.inProgress'),
	waiting: i18n.t('app.templates.details.waitingToStart'),
	unknown: i18n.t('app.templates.details.unknownState')
}));
function keyboard(event: KeyboardEvent) {
	if (props.disabled || !['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Home', 'End'].includes(event.key)) return;
	event.preventDefault();
	const index = tabs.value.findIndex((item) => item.id === props.tab);
	const next =
		event.key === 'Home'
			? 0
			: event.key === 'End'
				? 2
				: (index + (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : 2)) % 3;
	const value = tabs.value[next]!.id;
	emit('select', value);
	if (props.tab === value) document.getElementById(`${uid}-${value}-tab`)?.focus();
	else
		queueMicrotask(() => {
			if (props.tab === value && !props.disabled)
				document.getElementById(`${uid}-${value}-tab`)?.focus();
		});
}
</script>
ts
import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { cloneAsamFieldValue } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamListController, AsamListIntent, AsamFieldModel } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { DetailApplication, Family, RecordId, RecordRow, ReadIdentity } from './Types.js';

export const families: readonly Family[] = ['minimal', 'brand', 'tech'];
export function parseId(type: unknown, value: unknown): RecordId {
	if (
		type === 'number' &&
		typeof value === 'string' &&
		value.trim() !== '' &&
		Number.isFinite(Number(value))
	)
		return Number(value);
	if (type === 'string' && typeof value === 'string' && value !== '') return value;
	throw createAsamMessageError(
		new TypeError('记录 ID 必须是非空字符串或有限数字；拒绝 boolean/null'),
		'app.templates.details.recordIdMustBeANonemptyStringOrFinite'
	);
}
export function idKey(id: RecordId): string {
	if (!((typeof id === 'string' && id !== '') || (typeof id === 'number' && Number.isFinite(id))))
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			new TypeError('无效记录 ID'),
			'app.templates.details.invalidRecordId'
		);
	return `${typeof id}:${id}`;
}
export function listTarget(family: Family): string {
	return `/${family}/list`;
}
export function safeReturn(value: unknown, family: Family): string {
	return typeof value === 'string' && families.some((item) => value === listTarget(item))
		? value
		: listTarget(family);
}
export function identity(app: DetailApplication): ReadIdentity {
	return {
		identity: app.access.identity,
		scope: app.access.scope,
		revision: app.access.revision
	};
}
export function readable(app: DetailApplication): boolean {
	return app.access.allowed && !app.access.disabled && app.runtime.scope === app.access.scope;
}
export function gate(app: DetailApplication, action: string): boolean {
	if (!readable(app)) return false;
	const snapshot = identity(app),
		epoch = app.runtime.epoch,
		services = app.services;
	app.beforeAction?.(action);
	return (
		readable(app) &&
		services === app.services &&
		epoch === app.runtime.epoch &&
		snapshot.identity === app.access.identity &&
		snapshot.scope === app.access.scope &&
		snapshot.revision === app.access.revision
	);
}
export function remember(
	app: DetailApplication,
	controller: AsamListController<RecordRow>,
	family: Family
): boolean {
	const intent = controller.successfulSource.value;
	if (!controller.resultReady.value || !intent || !readable(app)) return false;
	app.returnState = {
		...identity(app),
		epoch: app.runtime.epoch,
		services: app.services,
		target: listTarget(family),
		intent: cloneAsamFieldValue(intent) as AsamListIntent
	};
	return true;
}
export function validReturn(app: DetailApplication, target: string): boolean {
	const saved = app.returnState;
	return (
		!!saved &&
		saved.target === target &&
		saved.services === app.services &&
		saved.epoch === app.runtime.epoch &&
		saved.identity === app.access.identity &&
		saved.scope === app.access.scope &&
		saved.revision === app.access.revision
	);
}
export async function restore(
	app: DetailApplication,
	controller: AsamListController<RecordRow>,
	target: string
): Promise<void> {
	if (!gate(app, 'restore-list')) return;
	const saved = validReturn(app, target) ? app.returnState : null;
	if (!saved) {
		await controller.submit();
		return;
	}
	const current = () =>
		readable(app) &&
		app.returnState === saved &&
		validReturn(app, target) &&
		!controller.dirty.value;
	if (
		(
			await controller.replaceConditions(
				cloneAsamFieldValue(saved.intent.query) as AsamFieldModel,
				{ mode: 'submit', force: true }
			)
		).status !== 'success'
	)
		return;
	if (!current()) return;
	if (
		controller.intent.value?.pageSize !== saved.intent.pageSize &&
		(await controller.setPageSize(saved.intent.pageSize)).status !== 'success'
	)
		return;
	if (!current()) return;
	if (saved.intent.sort && (await controller.setSort(saved.intent.sort)).status !== 'success')
		return;
	if (!current()) return;
	const last = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(controller.page.data.value.total / saved.intent.pageSize));
	await controller.setPage(Math.min(saved.intent.currentPage, last));
}

import type { InjectionKey } from 'vue';
import type { Router } from 'vue-router';
import type { AsamDataRuntime, AsamPage, AsamRequestContext, AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDetailResult, AsamListIntent, AsamListRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';

export type RecordId = string | number;
export type Family = 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'tech';
export type PageKind = 'list' | 'detail' | 'flow';
export type FlowTab = 'overview' | 'history' | 'related';
export interface RecordRow {
	readonly id: RecordId;
	readonly title: string;
	readonly owner: string;
	readonly organization: string;
	readonly state: string | number;
	readonly created: string;
}
export interface ReadIdentity {
	readonly identity: string;
	readonly scope: string;
	readonly revision: number;
}
export interface FlowStep {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly name: string;
	readonly state: 'done' | 'current' | 'waiting' | 'unknown';
}
export interface FlowRecord {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly actor: string;
	readonly at: string | null;
	readonly result: string;
	readonly state: string;
}
export interface FlowData {
	readonly stage: string;
	readonly steps: readonly FlowStep[];
	readonly records: readonly FlowRecord[];
	readonly related: readonly {
		readonly id: string;
		readonly title: string;
		readonly note: string;
	}[];
}
export interface DetailServices {
	dictionary(
		context: AsamRequestContext,
		identity: ReadIdentity
	): Promise<readonly { value: string | number; label: string }[]>;
	list(
		request: AsamListRequest,
		context: AsamRequestContext,
		identity: ReadIdentity
	): Promise<AsamPage<RecordRow>>;
	detail(
		id: RecordId,
		context: AsamRequestContext,
		identity: ReadIdentity
	): Promise<AsamDetailResult>;
	flow(id: RecordId, context: AsamRequestContext, identity: ReadIdentity): Promise<FlowData>;
	resolve(
		ids: readonly RecordId[],
		signal: AbortSignal
	): Promise<readonly { id: RecordId; name: string }[]>;
}
export interface PageAccess extends ReadIdentity {
	identity: string;
	scope: string;
	revision: number;
	disabled: boolean;
	readonly: boolean;
	allowed: boolean;
}
export interface ReturnState extends ReadIdentity {
	readonly epoch: number;
	readonly services: DetailServices;
	readonly target: string;
	readonly intent: AsamListIntent;
}
export interface DetailApplication {
	readonly runtime: AsamDataRuntime;
	readonly router: Router;
	readonly access: PageAccess;
	services: DetailServices;
	size: AsamControlSize;
	dark: boolean;
	returnState: ReturnState | null;
	/** 同步宿主通知，回调可能重入并修改身份/权限。回调后必须重新核门禁。 */
	beforeAction?: (action: string) => void;
}
export const detailApplicationKey: InjectionKey<DetailApplication> =
	Symbol('ASAM detail application');

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { BasicProfileHost } from '../basic/Types.js';
import { useBasicProfileText } from '../basic/I18n.js';
import BasicProfilePage from '../basic/BasicProfilePage.vue';

vue
<!-- 模板排版遵循仓库Prettier，以下仅关闭与其冲突的格式规则。 -->
<!-- eslint-disable vue/html-indent, vue/html-closing-bracket-newline, vue/html-self-closing, vue/multiline-html-element-content-newline, vue/max-attributes-per-line -->
<template>
	<section
		ref="element"
		class="advanced-workflow"
		:aria-label="text('审批进度', 'Approval progress')"
		data-advanced-flow
	>
		<h2>{{ text('审批进度', 'Approval progress') }}</h2>
		<template v-if="record?.flow"
			><p role="status" data-flow-stage>{{ record.flow.stage }}</p>
			<AsamSteps
				:active="active"
				finish-status="success"
				:direction="narrow ? 'vertical' : 'horizontal'"
				:space="narrow ? 88 : undefined"
				><AsamStep
					v-for="(step, index) in record.flow.steps"
					:key="step.id"
					:title="step.name"
					:status="
						step.state === 'done'
							? 'success'
							: step.state === 'current'
								? 'process'
								: 'wait'
					"
					:description="
						step.state === 'current'
							? text('当前阶段', 'Current stage')
							: step.state === 'unknown'
								? text('状态未知', 'Unknown status')
								: index === 0
									? record.history[0]?.time
									: step.state === 'waiting'
										? text('待处理', 'Pending')
										: text('已完成', 'Completed')
					"
					:aria-current="step.state === 'current' ? 'step' : undefined"
			/></AsamSteps>
			<details class="flow-source">
				<summary>
					{{ text('流程记录与关联资料', 'Flow records and related information') }}
				</summary>
				<FlowSections
					:data="record.flow"
					:loading="false"
					error=""
					:tab="flowTab"
					:disabled="!readable"
					@select="selectTab"
				/></details
		></template>
		<p v-else role="status">
			{{
				text(
					'流程读取未接入；不推断或推进审批状态。',
					'Flow reader is not connected; no approval state is inferred or advanced.'
				)
			}}
		</p>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSteps, AsamStep } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import FlowSections from '../../details/FlowSections.vue';
import type {} from './Models.js';
import type { FlowTab } from '../../details/Types.js';
import type { ProfileRecord } from '../basic/Types.js';
import { useBasicProfileText } from '../basic/I18n.js';
const props = defineProps<{ record: ProfileRecord | null; readable: boolean }>();
const { i18n } = useBasicProfileText();
const text = (zh: string, en: string) => (i18n.locale.value === 'en' ? en : zh);
const narrow = ref(false),
	flowTab = ref<FlowTab>('overview');
const active = computed(() =>
	Math.max(0, props.record?.flow?.steps.findIndex((step) => step.state === 'current') ?? -1)
);
const element = ref<HTMLElement>();
let observer: ResizeObserver | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	observer = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
		const width = entries[0]?.contentRect.width;
		if (width !== undefined) narrow.value = width <= 640;
	});
	if (element.value) observer.observe(element.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => observer?.disconnect());
function selectTab(value: string) {
	if (value === 'overview' || value === 'history' || value === 'related') flowTab.value = value;
}
</script>
<style scoped>
.advanced-workflow {
	margin-top: var(--asam-space-xl);
	min-width: 0;
	line-height: 1.75;
}

.advanced-workflow h2 {
	line-height: 2;
	font-size: 20px;
	font-weight: 500;
}

.advanced-workflow :deep([class~='el-step__title']),
.advanced-workflow :deep(h3) {
	line-height: 2;
}

.advanced-workflow :deep([class~='el-step__description']) {
	line-height: 1.5;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.advanced-workflow :deep(p),
.advanced-workflow :deep(li) {
	line-height: 1.75;
}

.flow-source {
	margin-top: var(--asam-space-lg);
}

.flow-source summary {
	cursor: pointer;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
	line-height: 1.5;
}

.flow-source :deep(.flow-steps),
.flow-source :deep(.flow-records),
.flow-source :deep(.related-items) {
	padding-left: 20px;
}

.flow-source :deep(button) {
	margin: 8px 8px 8px 0;
}
</style>

import { computed, reactive, watch } from 'vue';
import { createBasicProfileFixture } from '../basic/Fixture.js';
import { withAdvancedFlow } from './Flow.js';
import type { DetailServices } from '../../details/Types.js';

/** 本地只读流程adapter，签名沿旧DetailServices.flow；没有审批写入或新业务接口。 */
export function createAdvancedProfileFixture(locale: () => string) {
	const base = createBasicProfileFixture();
	const flowControls = reactive({ mode: 'normal' as 'normal' | 'error' | 'unknown' });
	const flowAudit = reactive({ reads: 0, aborted: 0 });
	let disposed = false;
	const pending = new Set<() => void>();
	const readFlow: DetailServices['flow'] = async (_id, context, request) => {
		flowAudit.reads++;
		const mode = flowControls.mode,
			english = locale() === 'en';
		const t = (zh: string, en: string) => (english ? en : zh);
		await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
			let done = false;
			const finish = (aborted: boolean) => {
				if (done) return;
				done = true;
				clearTimeout(timer);
				pending.delete(cancel);
				context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
				if (aborted) {
					flowAudit.aborted++;
					reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
				} else resolve();
			};
			const cancel = () => finish(true),
				timer = setTimeout(() => finish(false), base.controls.delayMs);
			pending.add(cancel);
			if (context.signal.aborted || disposed) cancel();
			else context.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
		});
		if (mode === 'error')
			throw Error(
				t('本地流程读取失败，请刷新详情重试', 'Local flow read failed; refresh to retry')
			);
		return {
			stage:
				mode === 'unknown'
					? t('流程状态未知', 'Flow status unknown')
					: t('待部门审批', 'Department approval pending'),
			steps: [
				{
					id: 'submitted',
					name: t('提交申请', 'Application submitted'),
					state: mode === 'unknown' ? 'unknown' : 'done'
				},
				{
					id: 'department',
					name: t('部门审批', 'Department approval'),
					state: mode === 'unknown' ? 'unknown' : 'current'
				},
				{ id: 'purchase', name: t('采购复核', 'Procurement review'), state: 'waiting' },
				{ id: 'inventory', name: t('设备入库', 'Equipment receipt'), state: 'waiting' },
				{ id: 'completed', name: t('完成', 'Completed'), state: 'waiting' }
			],
			records: [
				{
					id: 'submitted',
					actor:
						request.identity === 'reader-a'
							? t('林岚', 'Lin Lan')
							: t('周远', 'Zhou Yuan'),
					at: '2026-10-30T14:30:00Z',
					result: t('已提交本地合成申请', 'Local synthetic application submitted'),
					state: 'recorded'
				},
				{
					id: 'assigned',
					actor: t('审批流程', 'Approval workflow'),
					at: '2026-10-30T14:35:00Z',
					result: t(
						'已分配部门审批，未执行审批写入',
						'Department approval assigned; no approval write performed'
					),
					state: 'recorded'
				}
			],
			related: [
				{
					id: 'project',
					title: t('设备台账体验优化', 'Equipment register improvement'),
					note: t(
						'本地合成关联资料，原始对象保持独立',
						'Local synthetic relation; source objects remain separate'
					)
				}
			]
		};
	};
	const enrich = withAdvancedFlow(base.host.value, readFlow).enrich;
	const host = computed(() => ({ ...base.host.value, enrich }));
	const stop = watch(
		() => flowControls.mode,
		() => {
			base.controls.revision++;
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	return {
		...base,
		host,
		flowControls,
		flowAudit,
		dispose() {
			if (disposed) return;
			disposed = true;
			stop();
			for (const cancel of [...pending]) cancel();
			base.dispose();
		}
	};
}
ts
import type { DetailServices, FlowData } from '../../details/Types.js';
import type { BasicProfileHost } from '../basic/Types.js';
export type AdvancedProfileHost = BasicProfileHost;

/** 只校验旧流程读取协议的页面形状，不复制详情/编辑/写协调状态机。 */
export function decodeAdvancedFlow(value: FlowData): FlowData {
	if (
		!value ||
		typeof value.stage !== 'string' ||
		!Array.isArray(value.steps) ||
		value.steps.length !== 5
	)
		throw Error('Invalid five-stage flow');
	for (const rows of [value.steps, value.records, value.related]) {
		if (
			!Array.isArray(rows) ||
			rows.some((row) => !row || typeof row.id !== 'string' || !row.id.trim()) ||
			new Set(rows.map((row) => row.id)).size !== rows.length
		)
			throw Error('Invalid flow rows');
	}
	if (value.steps.filter((step) => step.state === 'current').length > 1)
		throw Error('Ambiguous current stage');
	for (const step of value.steps)
		if (
			typeof step.name !== 'string' ||
			!['done', 'current', 'waiting', 'unknown'].includes(step.state)
		)
			throw Error('Invalid flow step');
	for (const record of value.records)
		if (
			[record.actor, record.result, record.state].some((item) => typeof item !== 'string') ||
			(record.at !== null && typeof record.at !== 'string')
		)
			throw Error('Invalid flow history');
	for (const item of value.related)
		if (typeof item.title !== 'string' || typeof item.note !== 'string')
			throw Error('Invalid flow relation');
	return value;
}

/** 沿同一公开Detail请求读取旧flow协议，结果只经原控制器的当前会话提交。 */
export function withAdvancedFlow(
	host: BasicProfileHost,
	readFlow: DetailServices['flow']
): BasicProfileHost {
	return {
		...host,
		enrich: async (record, context, request) => {
			const flow = decodeAdvancedFlow(await readFlow(record.id, context, request));
			return { ...record, status: flow.stage, flow };
		}
	};
}

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
/** 演示边界拥有合成宿主与语言实例；传入的外部语言实例由调用者释放。 */
export function mountAdvancedProfile(
	element: Element,
	host?: { i18n?: AsamI18n; inheritAppearance?: boolean; diagnostics?: boolean },
	onError?: (error: unknown) => void
) {
	const locale = shallowRef<'zh-CN' | 'en'>('zh-CN');
	const i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value }));
	const app = createApp(App, {
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		diagnostics: host?.diagnostics,
		onLocale: (value: 'zh-CN' | 'en') => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'dashboard-advanced-profile-demo' });
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	app.mount(element);
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamRadioGroup as WebsiteAsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCard, AsamCheckboxItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import BasicProfilePage from './BasicProfilePage.vue';
import ProfileList from './ProfileList.vue';
import { createBasicProfileFixture } from './Fixture.js';
import { identityKey } from './Data.js';
import { useBasicProfileText } from './I18n.js';

const props = defineProps<{
	externalI18n?: AsamI18n;
	inheritAppearance?: boolean;
	diagnostics?: boolean;
	fixtureFactory?: typeof createBasicProfileFixture;
	demoNote?: string;
}>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ locale: [value: 'zh-CN' | 'en'] }>();
const { i18n, t } = useBasicProfileText(),
	fixture = props.fixtureFactory?.() ?? createBasicProfileFixture(),
	theme = ref<'light' | 'dark'>('light');
const size = ref<AsamControlSize>('default');
const listVisited = ref(false);
const listKey = computed(() =>
	JSON.stringify([identityKey(fixture.host.value.context), i18n.locale.value])
);
const listRows = computed(() => fixture.listRecords(i18n.locale.value));
watch(
	() => fixture.destination.value?.kind,
	(kind) => {
		if (kind === 'list') listVisited.value = true;
	}
);
const audit = computed(() => ({
	...fixture.audit,
	identity: fixture.controls.identity,
	scope: fixture.controls.scope,
	revision: fixture.controls.revision,
	theme: theme.value
}));
function setPolicy(key: 'readonly' | 'disabled' | 'denied', value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value === 'boolean') fixture.controls[key] = value;
}
function setLocale(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'zh-CN' || value === 'en') emit('locale', value);
}
function setTheme(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'light' || value === 'dark') theme.value = value;
}
function setMode(value: unknown) {
	if (
		value === 'normal' ||
		value === 'empty' ||
		value === 'error' ||
		value === 'missing' ||
		value === 'forbidden' ||
		value === 'zero' ||
		value === 'partial' ||
		value === 'long'
	)
		fixture.controls.mode = value;
}
function setNavigation(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'normal' || value === 'cancel' || value === 'error')
		fixture.controls.navigation = value;
}
function setWrite(value: unknown) {
	if (
		value === 'success' ||
		value === 'failure' ||
		value === 'unknown' ||
		value === 'not-applied'
	)
		fixture.controls.write = value;
}
function setVerify(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'resolve' || value === 'unknown') fixture.controls.verify = value;
}
function setId(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'number' || value === 'string' || value === 'invalid') fixture.setId(value);
}
function setSize(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'small' || value === 'default' || value === 'big' || value === 'large')
		size.value = value;
}
function setDelay(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 80 || value === 2000) fixture.controls.delayMs = value;
}
onBeforeUnmount(fixture.dispose);
</script>

					<AsamTag type="warning">{{ model.status }}</AsamTag
					><strong data-profile-total>{{ money(amount.totalCents) }}</strong
					><small>{{ t('amount') }}</small>
				</div>
			</header>
			<div class="profile-actions">
				<AsamButton
					:size="size"
					:disabled="!state.readable.value"
					@click="state.navigate(state.returnTarget.value)"
					type="primary"
					>{{ t('back') }}</AsamButton
				><AsamButton v-if="!advanced" type="primary" :size="size" disabled>{{
					t('approval')
				}}</AsamButton
				><AsamButton
					v-if="!advanced || (model && state.writable.value)"
					type="primary"
					plain
					:size="size"
					:disabled="!model || !state.writable.value || state.editor.busy.value"
					@click="state.edit"
					>{{ t('edit') }}</AsamButton
				><AsamButton
					:size="size"
					:disabled="!model || !state.readable.value"
					@click="more = !more"
					type="primary"
					>{{ t('more') }}</AsamButton
				>
			</div>
			<p class="profile-muted">{{ t('approvalUnavailable') }}</p>
			<slot name="workflow" :record="model" :readable="state.readable.value" />
			<p v-if="host.readonly || host.disabled || !host.allowed" role="status">
				{{ t('restricted') }}
			</p>
			<p v-if="state.feedback.value" role="status">{{ feedbackText }}</p>
			<p v-if="localFeedback" role="status">{{ t(localFeedback) }}</p>
			<div v-if="more" class="profile-actions" data-profile-more>
				<AsamButton :size="size" @click="copyCode" type="primary">{{
					t('copyCode')
				}}</AsamButton
				><AsamButton :size="size" @click="downloadSummary" type="primary">{{
					t('downloadSummary')
				}}</AsamButton>
			</div></AsamCard
		><AsamDetailPanel :controller="state.panel" :title="headingTitle ?? t('title')" embedded
			><template #default="{ status }"
				><template v-if="status === 'ready' && model"
					><AsamTabs
						:model-value="state.tab.value"
						:items="tabs"
						:aria-label="t('sections')"
						@update:model-value="selectTab"
					/>
					<div v-if="state.tab.value === 'detail'" class="profile-columns">
						<div class="profile-stack">
							<AsamCard
								shadow="never"
								:body-style="body"
								data-profile-section="fields"
								><FieldGroups
									:data="fieldData"
									:bindings="bindings"
									:groups="[t('info')]"
									:session="state.detail.session.value"
									:active="state.readable.value"
									:size="size" /></AsamCard
							><AsamCard
								:title="t('lines')"
								shadow="never"
								:body-style="body"
								data-profile-section="lines"
								><div class="profile-table">
									<AsamTable :data="rows" :empty-text="t('empty')"
										><!-- @vue-generic {ProfileLine} --><AsamTableColumn
											prop="name"
											:label="t('equipment')"
											min-width="160"
											><template #default="{ row }"
												><AsamButton
													class="profile-line-link"
													type="primary"
													link
													:size="size"
													@click="selectedLine = row"
													>{{ row.name }}</AsamButton
												></template
											></AsamTableColumn
										><!-- @vue-generic {ProfileLine} --><AsamTableColumn
											prop="specification"
											:label="t('specification')"
											min-width="130"
										/><!-- @vue-generic {ProfileLine} --><AsamTableColumn
											prop="quantity"
											:label="t('quantity')"
											width="80"
										/><!-- @vue-generic {ProfileLine} --><AsamTableColumn
											:label="t('price')"
											min-width="110"
											align="right"
											><template #default="{ row }">{{
												money(row.priceCents)
											}}</template></AsamTableColumn
										><!-- @vue-generic {ProfileLine} --><AsamTableColumn
											:label="t('lineAmount')"
											min-width="130"
											align="right"
											><template #default="{ row }">{{
												money(lineAmount(row))
											}}</template></AsamTableColumn
										></AsamTable
									>
								</div>
								<div class="profile-total">
									<span>{{ t('total') }}</span
									><strong data-profile-table-total>{{
										money(amount.totalCents)
									}}</strong>
								</div>
								<p v-if="amount.missing" role="status">
									{{ t('partialAmount') }} {{ money(amount.knownCents) }}
								</p></AsamCard
							><AsamCard
								:title="t('notes')"
								shadow="never"
								:body-style="body"
								data-profile-section="attachments"
								><p>{{ model.note }}</p>
								<div v-for="file in model.attachments" :key="file.id">
									<AsamLink type="primary" @click="attachment = file">{{
										file.name
									}}</AsamLink>
								</div>
								<p v-if="!model.attachments.length" class="profile-muted">
									{{ t('emptyAttachments') }}
								</p></AsamCard
							>
						</div>
						<aside class="profile-stack">
							<AsamCard
								:title="t('summary')"
								shadow="never"
								:body-style="body"
								data-profile-section="summary"
								><AsamDescriptions direction="vertical" :column="1"
									><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="t('handler')"
										><div class="profile-inline">
											<AsamAvatar :size="24">{{
												model.handler.slice(0, 1)
											}}</AsamAvatar
											>{{ model.handler }}
										</div></AsamDescriptionsItem
									><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="t('expected')">{{
										model.expected
									}}</AsamDescriptionsItem
									><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="t('relatedProject')"
										><AsamLink
											type="primary"
											@click="state.tab.value = 'related'"
											>{{ model.related.title }}</AsamLink
										></AsamDescriptionsItem
									></AsamDescriptions
								></AsamCard
							><AsamCard
								:title="t('recent')"
								shadow="never"
								:body-style="body"
								data-profile-section="recent"
								><AsamTimeline
									><AsamTimelineItem
										v-for="(item, index) in model.history"
										:key="item.id"
										:type="index === 0 ? 'primary' : 'info'"
										:timestamp="item.time"
										placement="top"
										><strong>{{ item.action }}</strong>
										<p class="profile-muted">
											{{ item.actor }}
										</p></AsamTimelineItem
									></AsamTimeline
								>
								<p v-if="!model.history.length">{{ t('empty') }}</p></AsamCard
							>
						</aside>
					</div>
					<AsamCard
						v-else-if="state.tab.value === 'history'"
						:title="t('history')"
						shadow="never"
						:body-style="body"
						data-profile-history
						><div class="profile-table">
							<AsamTable :data="visibleHistory" :empty-text="t('empty')"
								><!-- @vue-generic {ProfileHistory} --><AsamTableColumn
									prop="action"
									:label="t('action')"
									min-width="170"
								/><!-- @vue-generic {ProfileHistory} --><AsamTableColumn
									prop="actor"
									:label="t('actor')"
									min-width="130"
								/><!-- @vue-generic {ProfileHistory} --><AsamTableColumn
									:label="t('opinion')"
									min-width="240"
									><template #default="{ row }"
										><div class="profile-opinion">
											<span :id="opinionId + '-' + row.id">{{
												row.opinion &&
												row.opinion.length > 48 &&
												expandedOpinion !== row.id
													? row.opinion.slice(0, 48) + '…'
													: row.opinion || '—'
											}}</span
											><AsamButton
												v-if="row.opinion && row.opinion.length > 48"
												type="primary"
												link
												v-bind="{
													'aria-expanded': expandedOpinion === row.id,
													'aria-controls': opinionId + '-' + row.id
												}"
												@click="
													expandedOpinion =
														expandedOpinion === row.id
															? undefined
															: row.id
												"
												>{{
													t(
														expandedOpinion === row.id
															? 'collapseOpinion'
															: 'expandOpinion'
													)
												}}</AsamButton
											>
										</div></template
									></AsamTableColumn
								><!-- @vue-generic {ProfileHistory} --><AsamTableColumn
									prop="time"
									:label="t('time')"
									min-width="170"
								/><!-- @vue-generic {ProfileHistory} --><AsamTableColumn
									:label="t('operationResult')"
									min-width="130"
									><template #default="{ row }">{{
										row.result || '—'
									}}</template></AsamTableColumn
								></AsamTable
							>
						</div>
						<nav
							v-if="advanced && history.length > historyPageSize"
							class="profile-history-pagination"
							:aria-label="t('historyPagination')"
						>
							<AsamPagination
								v-model:current-page="historyPage"
								:page-size="historyPageSize"
								:total="history.length"
								:size="size"
								layout="prev, pager, next"
							/></nav></AsamCard
					><AsamCard
						v-else
						:title="t('related')"
						shadow="never"
						:body-style="body"
						data-profile-related
						><div class="profile-related">
							<AsamAvatar shape="square">{{
								model.related.title.slice(0, 1)
							}}</AsamAvatar>
							<div>
								<h3>{{ model.related.title }}</h3>
								<p>{{ model.related.description }}</p>
							</div>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								plain
								:size="size"
								@click="state.navigate(model.related.target)"
								>{{ t('viewProject') }}</AsamButton
							>
						</div></AsamCard
					></template
				></template
			></AsamDetailPanel
		><AsamFormDialog
			class="basic-profile-editor"
			:controller="state.editor"
			:title="t('edit')"
			:field-labels="{ purpose: t('purpose') }"
			:size="size"
			:columns="1"
			width="min(560px, calc(100vw - 32px))"
			:fallback-focus="() => heading ?? null"
			><template #unknown-help
				><p>{{ t('unknownHelp') }}</p></template
			></AsamFormDialog
		><AsamDialog
			:model-value="!!selectedLine"
			:title="selectedLine?.name ?? t('lines')"
			width="min(560px, calc(100vw - 32px))"
			@update:model-value="closeLine"
			><AsamDescriptions v-if="selectedLine" :column="1"
				><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="t('specification')">{{
					selectedLine.specification || '—'
				}}</AsamDescriptionsItem
				><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="t('quantity')">{{
					selectedLine.quantity
				}}</AsamDescriptionsItem
				><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="t('price')">{{
					money(selectedLine.priceCents)
				}}</AsamDescriptionsItem
				><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="t('lineAmount')">{{
					money(lineAmount(selectedLine))
				}}</AsamDescriptionsItem></AsamDescriptions
			><template #footer
				><AsamButton :size="size" @click="closeLine(false)" type="primary">{{
					t('close')
				}}</AsamButton></template
			></AsamDialog
		><AsamDialog
			class="basic-profile-attachment"
			:model-value="!!attachment"
			:title="attachment?.name ?? t('attachment')"
			width="min(560px, calc(100vw - 32px))"
			@update:model-value="closeAttachment"
			><p>{{ t('localAttachment') }}</p>
			<pre>{{ attachment?.content }}</pre>
			<template #footer
				><AsamButton @click="attachment = undefined" type="primary">{{
					t('close')
				}}</AsamButton
				><AsamButton type="primary" @click="downloadAttachment">{{
					t('downloadAttachment')
				}}</AsamButton></template
			></AsamDialog
		>
	</main>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, provide, ref, shallowRef, useId, watch } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCard,
	AsamTag,
	AsamButton,
	AsamTabs,
	AsamDescriptions,
	AsamDescriptionsItem,
	AsamTable,
	AsamTableColumn,
	AsamPagination,
	AsamLink,
	AsamAvatar,
	AsamTimeline,
	AsamTimelineItem,
	AsamDialog
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { AsamDetailPanel, AsamFormDialog } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamFieldViewBinding } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import FieldGroups from '../../details/FieldGroups.vue';
import type {} from '../../cards/Models.js';
import { createBasicProfile, profileFields } from './State.js';
import { totals, lineAmount, formatProfileCents } from './Data.js';
import { useBasicProfileText } from './I18n.js';
import type { BasicProfileHost, ProfileLine, ProfileRecord } from './Types.js';
type ProfileHistory = ProfileRecord['history'][number];
const props = withDefaults(
	defineProps<{
		host: BasicProfileHost;
		size?: AsamControlSize;
		headingTitle?: string;
		advanced?: boolean;
	}>(),
	{
		size: 'default',
		headingTitle: undefined
	}
);
const { i18n, t } = useBasicProfileText();
provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
const state = createBasicProfile(
		() => props.host,
		() => i18n.locale.value
	),
	model = state.model;
const heading = ref<HTMLElement>(),
	more = ref(false),
	attachment = shallowRef<ProfileRecord['attachments'][number]>();
const selectedLine = shallowRef<ProfileLine>();
const localFeedback = ref<'copied' | 'copyFailed' | ''>('');
const opinionId = useId();
const expandedOpinion = ref<string>();
const tabs = computed(() => [
	{ value: 'detail', label: t('detail') },
	{ value: 'history', label: t('history') },
	{ value: 'related', label: t('related') }
]);
const bindings = computed<AsamFieldViewBinding[]>(() =>
	profileFields.map((field) => ({
		field: {
			...field,
			label: t(
				field.key as 'code' | 'applicant' | 'department' | 'date' | 'purpose' | 'budget'
			),
			modes: { detail: { layout: { group: t('info') } } }
		}
	}))
);
const fieldData = computed(() => ({
	...state.detail.data.value,
	budget: money(amount.value.totalCents)
}));
const rows = computed<ProfileLine[]>(() => [...(model.value?.lines ?? [])]),
	history = computed<ProfileHistory[]>(() => [...(model.value?.history ?? [])]);
const historyPageSize = 2;
const historyPage = ref(1);
const visibleHistory = computed(() => {
	if (!props.advanced) return history.value;
	const start = (historyPage.value - 1) * historyPageSize;
	return history.value.slice(start, start + historyPageSize);
});
const amount = computed(() => totals(model.value?.lines ?? []));
const feedbackText = computed(() => {
	const key = state.feedback.value;
	return key === 'opened' ||
		key === 'navigationCancelled' ||
		key === 'navigationFailed' ||
		key === 'invalidId' ||
		key === 'operationMissing'
		? t(key)
		: '';
});
const body = { padding: 'var(--asam-space-xl)' };
const money = (cents: number | null) => formatProfileCents(cents, i18n.locale.value);
function selectTab(value: string | number) {
	if (value === 'detail' || value === 'history' || value === 'related') state.tab.value = value;
}
watch(model, () => {
	attachment.value = undefined;
	selectedLine.value = undefined;
	more.value = false;
	expandedOpinion.value = undefined;
	localFeedback.value = '';
});
watch(history, (records) => {
	const lastPage = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(records.length / historyPageSize));
	historyPage.value = Math.min(historyPage.value, lastPage);
});
watch(
	[() => props.host.context.identity, () => props.host.context.scope, () => props.host.id],
	() => {
		historyPage.value = 1;
	}
);
function closeLine(value: boolean) {
	if (!value) selectedLine.value = undefined;
}
function closeAttachment(value: unknown) {
	if (value === false) attachment.value = undefined;
}
async function copyCode() {
	const record = model.value;
	if (!record || !state.readable.value) return;
	try {
		await navigator.clipboard.writeText(record.code);
		if (model.value === record) localFeedback.value = 'copied';
	} catch {
		if (model.value === record) localFeedback.value = 'copyFailed';
	}
}
const downloadUrls = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
function download(name: string, content: string, type: string) {
	const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([content], { type }));
	const anchor = document.createElement('a');
	anchor.href = url;
	anchor.download = name;
	anchor.hidden = true;
	document.body.append(anchor);
	try {
		anchor.click();
	} finally {
		anchor.remove();
		downloadUrls.set(
			url,
			setTimeout(() => {
				URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
				downloadUrls.delete(url);
			}, 1000)
		);
	}
}

function downloadSummary() {
	if (!model.value || !state.readable.value) return;
	download(
		model.value.code + '.json',
		JSON.stringify(
			{
				code: model.value.code,
				title: model.value.title,
				purpose: model.value.fields.purpose,
				lines: model.value.lines,
				totalCents: amount.value.totalCents,
				localDemo: true
			},
			null,
			2
		),
		'application/json'
	);
}
function downloadAttachment() {
	if (attachment.value && state.readable.value)
		download(attachment.value.name, attachment.value.content, 'text/plain;charset=utf-8');
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	state.dispose();
	for (const [url, timer] of downloadUrls) {
		clearTimeout(timer);
		URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
	}
	downloadUrls.clear();
});
</script>

ts
import { idKey } from '../../details/Protocol.js';
import type { ProfileRecord, ProfileLine } from './Types.js';
export const identityKey = (context: { scope: string; identity: string; revision: number }) =>
	JSON.stringify([context.scope, context.identity, context.revision]);
/** Exact CNY cent display: never convert a full cent amount to floating-point yuan. */
export function formatProfileCents(cents: number | null, locale: string): string {
	if (cents === null) return '—';
	if (!Number.isSafeInteger(cents)) throw new RangeError('Invalid integer cents');
	const language = locale === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh-CN';
	const integer = BigInt(cents);
	const major = integer / 100n;
	const minor = Number((integer < 0n ? -integer : integer) % 100n);
	const fraction = new Intl.NumberFormat(language, {
		useGrouping: false,
		minimumIntegerDigits: 2,
		maximumFractionDigits: 0
	}).format(minor);
	const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(language, {
		style: 'currency',
		currency: 'CNY',
		minimumFractionDigits: 2,
		maximumFractionDigits: 2
	});
	// BigInt has no negative zero; keep Intl's existing sign for -0 and sub-yuan negatives.
	const value = major === 0n && (cents < 0 || Object.is(cents, -0)) ? -0 : major;
	return formatter
		.formatToParts(value)
		.map((part) => (part.type === 'fraction' ? fraction : part.value))
		.join('');
}
export function lineAmount(line: ProfileLine): number | null {
	return line.priceCents === null ? null : line.priceCents * line.quantity;
}
export function totals(lines: readonly ProfileLine[]) {
	let knownCents = 0,
		missing = false;
	for (const line of lines) {
		const amount = lineAmount(line);
		if (amount === null) missing = true;
		else {
			knownCents += amount;
			if (!Number.isSafeInteger(knownCents)) throw Error('Amount overflow');
		}
	}
	return { knownCents, totalCents: missing ? null : knownCents, missing };
}
/** 保留ID类型、0和缺失；整份校验后复制，不拼入旧身份数据。 */
export function decodeProfile(input: ProfileRecord, expected: string | number): ProfileRecord {
	if (
		!input ||
		idKey(input.id) !== idKey(expected) ||
		!input.fields ||
		typeof input.fields !== 'object' ||
		Array.isArray(input.fields)
	)
		throw Error('Invalid profile record');
	for (const key of ['code', 'title', 'status', 'note', 'handler', 'expected'])
		if (typeof Reflect.get(input, key) !== 'string') throw Error('Invalid profile text');
	for (const key of ['code', 'applicant', 'department', 'date', 'purpose', 'budget']) {
		const value = input.fields[key];
		if (value !== undefined && value !== null && typeof value !== 'string')
			throw Error('Invalid profile field');
	}
	for (const rows of [input.lines, input.attachments, input.history]) {
		if (
			!Array.isArray(rows) ||
			rows.some((row) => !row || typeof row.id !== 'string' || !row.id.trim()) ||
			new Set(rows.map((row) => row.id)).size !== rows.length
		)
			throw Error('Invalid profile rows');
	}
	for (const row of input.lines)
		if (
			typeof row.name !== 'string' ||
			typeof row.specification !== 'string' ||
			!Number.isSafeInteger(row.quantity) ||
			row.quantity < 0 ||
			(row.priceCents !== null &&
				(!Number.isSafeInteger(row.priceCents) ||
					row.priceCents < 0 ||
					!Number.isSafeInteger(lineAmount(row))))
		)
			throw Error('Invalid purchase line');
	for (const row of input.attachments)
		if (typeof row.name !== 'string' || typeof row.content !== 'string')
			throw Error('Invalid local attachment');
	for (const row of input.history)
		if (
			[row.action, row.actor, row.time].some((value) => typeof value !== 'string') ||
			[row.opinion, row.result].some(
				(value) => value !== undefined && typeof value !== 'string'
			)
		)
			throw Error('Invalid history');
	if (
		!input.related ||
		[input.related.title, input.related.description, input.related.target].some(
			(value) => typeof value !== 'string'
		)
	)
		throw Error('Invalid related record');
	totals(input.lines);
	const copy = structuredClone(input);
	function freeze(value: object) {
		Object.freeze(value);
		for (const child of Object.values(value))
			if (child && typeof child === 'object') freeze(child);
	}
	freeze(copy);
	return copy;
}

import { computed, reactive, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { createAsamWriteCoordinator } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createAsamMessageIssue } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { idKey } from '../../details/Protocol.js';
import { createTemplateId } from '../../shared/Id.js';
import { identityKey, totals, formatProfileCents } from './Data.js';
import type { BasicProfileHost, ProfileRecord, ProfileRequest, ProfileReceipt } from './Types.js';
import type {} from './I18n.js';

const applicationCount = 24;
export interface ProfileListRecord {
	readonly id: number;
	readonly code: string;
	readonly title: string;
}

function applicationRecord(id: number, locale: string): ProfileListRecord {
	const testEquipment = id % 3 !== 2;
	return {
		id,
		code: `SQ-20261030-${String(18 + id).padStart(3, '0')}`,
		title:
			locale === 'en'
				? testEquipment
					? 'Development test equipment purchase'
					: 'Office equipment purchase'
				: testEquipment
					? '研发测试设备采购'
					: '办公设备采购'
	};
}

export function createBasicProfileFixture() {
	const controls = reactive({
		identity: 'reader-a',
		scope: 'synthetic-east',
		revision: 1,
		id: 'number' as 'number' | 'string' | 'invalid',
		disabled: false,
		readonly: false,
		denied: false,
		mode: 'normal' as
			'normal' | 'missing' | 'forbidden' | 'error' | 'empty' | 'zero' | 'partial' | 'long',
		write: 'success' as 'success' | 'failure' | 'unknown' | 'not-applied',
		verify: 'resolve' as 'resolve' | 'unknown',
		delayMs: 80,
		navigation: 'normal' as 'normal' | 'cancel' | 'error'
	});
	const audit = reactive({
		reads: 0,
		saves: 0,
		verifies: 0,
		aborted: 0,
		navigations: 0,
		lastOperation: ''
	});
	const destination = shallowRef<{
		kind: 'list' | 'related';
		title: string;
		description: string;
		items: readonly string[];
	}>();
	const selectedId = shallowRef(0);
	const coordinator = createAsamWriteCoordinator();
	const operationIds = new Map<string, string>(),
		purposes = new Map<string, string>();
	const operations = new Map<
		string,
		{ request: ProfileRequest; purpose: string; applied: boolean; receipt: ProfileReceipt }
	>();
	const pending = new Set<() => void>();
	let disposed = false,
		navigationEpoch = 0;
	const context = computed(() => ({
		identity: controls.identity,
		scope: controls.scope,
		revision: controls.revision
	}));
	const id = computed(() =>
		controls.id === 'number' ? selectedId.value : controls.id === 'string' ? '0' : NaN
	);
	const current = (input: ProfileRequest) =>
		!disposed &&
		identityKey(input) === identityKey(context.value) &&
		Object.is(input.id, id.value) &&
		!controls.disabled &&
		!controls.denied &&
		!input.signal.aborted;
	const storageKey = (input: ProfileRequest) =>
		JSON.stringify([input.scope, input.identity, idKey(input.id)]);
	const choose = (input: ProfileRequest, zh: string, en: string) =>
		input.locale === 'en' ? en : zh;
	const stopNav = watch(
		[
			() => context.value,
			() => id.value,
			() => controls.disabled,
			() => controls.denied,
			() => controls.navigation
		],
		() => {
			navigationEpoch++;
			destination.value = undefined;
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	function wait(signal: AbortSignal) {
		return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
			let settled = false;
			const finish = (aborted: boolean) => {
				if (settled) return;
				settled = true;
				clearTimeout(timer);
				signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
				pending.delete(cancel);
				if (aborted) {
					audit.aborted++;
					reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
				} else resolve();
			};
			const cancel = () => finish(true),
				timer = setTimeout(() => finish(false), controls.delayMs);
			pending.add(cancel);
			if (signal.aborted || disposed) cancel();
			else signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
		});
	}
	function record(input: ProfileRequest, mode = controls.mode): ProfileRecord {
		const t = (zh: string, en: string) => choose(input, zh, en);
		const { code, title } = applicationRecord(
			typeof input.id === 'number' ? input.id : 0,
			input.locale
		);
		const purpose =
			purposes.get(storageKey(input)) ??
			t('研发测试设备补充', 'Additional equipment for development testing');
		const lines =
			mode === 'empty'
				? []
				: [
						{
							id: 'workstation',
							name: t('便携式工作站', 'Portable workstation'),
							specification: '32GB / 1TB',
							quantity: mode === 'zero' ? 0 : 2,
							priceCents: mode === 'partial' ? null : 998000
						},
						{
							id: 'monitor',
							name: t('显示器', 'Monitor'),
							specification: t('27英寸 / 4K', '27 inch / 4K'),
							quantity: mode === 'zero' ? 0 : 2,
							priceCents: 198000
						},
						{
							id: 'dock',
							name: t('扩展坞', 'Docking station'),
							specification: t('多接口扩展', 'Multi-port expansion'),
							quantity: mode === 'zero' ? 0 : 2,
							priceCents: 38000
						}
					];
		const total = totals(lines).totalCents;
		const money = formatProfileCents(total, input.locale);
		return {
			id: input.id,
			code,
			title,
			status: t('待部门审批', 'Awaiting department approval'),
			fields: {
				code,
				applicant:
					input.identity === 'reader-a' ? t('林岚', 'Lin Lan') : t('周远', 'Zhou Yuan'),
				department: t('研发运营组', 'Engineering operations'),
				date: '2026-10-30',
				purpose: mode === 'long' ? purpose.repeat(8) : purpose,
				budget: money
			},
			lines,
			note: t(
				'用于研发测试环境扩充及设备更新，预计覆盖两组并行测试任务。设备到货后统一登记资产编号，由研发运营组负责验收与交接。',
				'Expand the development test environment for two parallel teams. Engineering operations will register, inspect and hand over the equipment.'
			),
			attachments:
				mode === 'empty'
					? []
					: [
							{
								id: 'requirements',
								name: t(
									'采购需求清单（本地示例）.txt',
									'Purchase requirements (local example).txt'
								),
								content:
									t(
										'本地合成附件，非正式采购资料。',
										'Local synthetic attachment, not an official purchase document.'
									) +
									'\n' +
									lines.map((row) => row.name + ' × ' + row.quantity).join('\n')
							}
						],
			handler: t('陈晓', 'Chen Xiao'),
			expected: '2026-11-02',
			history:
				mode === 'empty'
					? []
					: [
							{
								id: 'submitted',
								action: t('已提交申请', 'Application submitted'),
								actor: t('林岚', 'Lin Lan'),
								time: '2026-10-30 14:30',
								opinion: t(
									'已核对设备规格、数量和预算。两组研发测试并行执行，请采购复核到货周期和可替换型号，并在提交订单前把交接计划同步给研发运营组。',
									'Equipment specifications, quantities and budget were checked. Procurement should confirm delivery times and substitute models before sharing the handover plan with Engineering Operations.'
								),
								result: t('已提交', 'Submitted')
							},
							{
								id: 'assigned',
								action: t('已分配部门审批', 'Department review assigned'),
								actor: t('审批流程', 'Review workflow'),
								time: '2026-10-30 14:35',
								result: t('已分配', 'Assigned')
							},
							{
								id: 'waiting',
								action: t('等待处理', 'Waiting for review'),
								actor: t('陈晓', 'Chen Xiao'),
								time: t('当前阶段', 'Current stage')
							}
						],
			related: {
				title: t('设备台账体验优化', 'Asset register experience'),
				description: t('研发工程 · 负责人 林岚', 'Engineering project · Owner Lin Lan'),
				target: '/profile/related/asset-register'
			}
		};
	}
	const services: BasicProfileHost['services'] = {
		async load(input) {
			audit.reads++;
			const mode = controls.mode;
			await wait(input.signal);
			if (!current(input)) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
			if (mode === 'error')
				throw Error(choose(input, '合成详情读取失败', 'Synthetic detail read failed'));
			if (mode === 'missing' || mode === 'forbidden') return { status: mode };
			return { status: 'ready', record: record(input, mode) };
		},
		async save(payload, operation, input) {
			audit.saves++;
			audit.lastOperation = operation.target.operationId;
			const mode = controls.write,
				purpose = String(payload.purpose ?? '');
			const receipt: ProfileReceipt = {
				operationId: operation.target.operationId,
				identityKey: identityKey(input),
				id: input.id
			};
			operations.set(operation.target.operationId, {
				request: input,
				purpose,
				applied: false,
				receipt
			});
			await wait(input.signal);
			if (!current(input) || controls.readonly)
				throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
			if (mode === 'failure')
				return Object.assign(
					createAsamMessageIssue(
						'本地演示保存失败，尚未应用修改',
						'app.templates.basicProfile.saveFailed'
					),
					{ status: 'failure' as const }
				);
			const applied = mode !== 'not-applied';
			if (applied) purposes.set(storageKey(input), purpose);
			operations.set(operation.target.operationId, {
				request: input,
				purpose,
				applied,
				receipt
			});
			return mode === 'success'
				? { status: 'success', data: receipt }
				: Object.assign(
						createAsamMessageIssue(
							'原本地操作结果未知，请核实原操作',
							'app.templates.basicProfile.writeUnknown'
						),
						{ status: 'unknown' as const }
					);
		},
		async verify(operation, input) {
			audit.verifies++;
			audit.lastOperation = operation.target.operationId;
			await wait(input.signal);
			if (!current(input) || controls.verify === 'unknown') return { status: 'unknown' };
			const found = operations.get(operation.target.operationId);
			if (
				!found ||
				identityKey(found.request) !== identityKey(input) ||
				found.request.id !== input.id
			)
				return { status: 'unknown' };
			return found.applied
				? { status: 'success', data: found.receipt }
				: { status: 'not-applied' };
		}
	};
	const navigate: BasicProfileHost['navigate'] = async (target, input) => {
		const epoch = navigationEpoch,
			mode = controls.navigation;
		await wait(input.signal);
		if (!current(input) || epoch !== navigationEpoch || mode === 'cancel') return false;
		if (mode === 'error') throw Error('Local navigation failed');
		const model = record(input);
		if (['/minimal/list', '/brand/list', '/tech/list'].includes(target))
			destination.value = {
				kind: 'list',
				title: choose(input, '本地申请列表', 'Local application list'),
				description: choose(
					input,
					'筛选本地合成申请，打开详情后可返回当前结果页。',
					'Filter local synthetic requests and return to the same results page after viewing details.'
				),
				items: [model.code, model.title]
			};
		else if (target === model.related.target)
			destination.value = {
				kind: 'related',
				title: model.related.title,
				description: model.related.description,
				items: [
					model.code,
					choose(
						input,
						'项目资料与关联采购申请',
						'Project resources and linked purchase request'
					)
				]
			};
		else return false;
		audit.navigations++;
		return true;
	};
	const host = computed<BasicProfileHost>(() => ({
		context: context.value,
		id: id.value,
		services,
		coordinator,
		returnTo: '/minimal/list',
		allowed: !controls.denied,
		disabled: controls.disabled,
		readonly: controls.readonly,
		navigate,
		operationId(who, recordId) {
			const key = JSON.stringify([identityKey(who), idKey(recordId)]);
			let value = operationIds.get(key);
			if (!value) {
				value = createTemplateId();
				operationIds.set(key, value);
			}
			return value;
		},
		onSaved(receipt) {
			const key = JSON.stringify([receipt.identityKey, idKey(receipt.id)]);
			if (operationIds.get(key) === receipt.operationId) operationIds.delete(key);
		}
	}));
	return {
		host,
		controls,
		audit,
		destination,
		listRecords(locale: string) {
			return Array.from({ length: applicationCount }, (_, id) =>
				applicationRecord(id, locale)
			);
		},
		openListRecord(recordId: number) {
			if (
				disposed ||
				controls.disabled ||
				controls.denied ||
				destination.value?.kind !== 'list' ||
				!Number.isInteger(recordId) ||
				recordId < 0 ||
				recordId >= applicationCount
			)
				return;
			selectedId.value = recordId;
			controls.id = 'number';
			destination.value = undefined;
		},
		setId(mode: typeof controls.id) {
			selectedId.value = 0;
			controls.id = mode;
		},
		back() {
			destination.value = undefined;
		},
		switchIdentity() {
			controls.identity = controls.identity === 'reader-a' ? 'reader-b' : 'reader-a';
		},
		dispose() {
			if (disposed) return;
			disposed = true;
			stopNav();
			for (const cancel of [...pending]) cancel();
			destination.value = undefined;
		}
	};
}

import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamProTable, AsamSearchForm, useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamListColumn } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { ProfileListRecord } from './Fixture.js';
import { useBasicProfileText } from './I18n.js';

const props = defineProps<{ rows: readonly ProfileListRecord[]; size: AsamControlSize }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ open: [id: number] }>();
const { t } = useBasicProfileText();
const columns = computed<AsamListColumn<ProfileListRecord>[]>(() => [
	{ key: 'code', label: t('code'), width: 180 },
	{ key: 'title', label: t('application') }
]);
const controller = useAsamListController<ProfileListRecord>({
	fields: [{ key: 'keyword', kind: 'text', label: t('application') }],
	initial: { keyword: '' },
	rowKey: 'id',
	runtime: createAsamDataRuntime(),
	api: async ({ query, currentPage, pageSize }) => {
		const keyword = String(query.keyword ?? '')
			.trim()
			.toLocaleLowerCase();
		const matches = props.rows.filter(({ code, title }) =>
			`${code} ${title}`.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(keyword)
		);
		const offset = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
		return { list: matches.slice(offset, offset + pageSize), total: matches.length };
	}
});

import { computed, shallowRef, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamDetail, useAsamEditor } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamDetailController,
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamWriteCoordinator
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createAsamMessageIssue } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { idKey, safeReturn } from '../../details/Protocol.js';
import { identityKey, decodeProfile } from './Data.js';
import type {
	BasicProfileHost,
	ProfileRecord,
	ProfileRequest,
	ProfileReceipt,
	ProfileServices
} from './Types.js';
import type {} from './I18n.js';

// 只保存原写调用的服务路由；pending状态和重复写控制仍完全归公开coordinator。
const writeRoutes = new WeakMap<
	AsamWriteCoordinator,
	Map<string, { services: ProfileServices; request: Omit<ProfileRequest, 'signal'> }>
>();
const routeKey = (scope: string, operationId: string) => JSON.stringify([scope, operationId]);
export const profileFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	'code',
	'applicant',
	'department',
	'date',
	'purpose',
	'budget'
].map((key) => ({ key, label: key, kind: key === 'purpose' ? 'textarea' : 'text' }));
const editFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{
		key: 'purpose',
		label: 'purpose',
		kind: 'textarea',
		modes: { edit: { componentProps: { rows: 3, maxlength: 400, showWordLimit: true } } }
	}
];
const receiptMatches = (
	value: unknown,
	request: ProfileRequest,
	operationId: string
): value is ProfileReceipt =>
	!!value &&
	typeof value === 'object' &&
	Reflect.get(value, 'operationId') === operationId &&
	Reflect.get(value, 'identityKey') === identityKey(request) &&
	Reflect.get(value, 'id') === request.id;
/** 拥有本页runtime；原公开Detail/Editor独占读取、写协调和未知结果流程。 */
export function createBasicProfile(getHost: () => BasicProfileHost, locale: () => string) {
	const coordinator = getHost().coordinator;
	let routes = writeRoutes.get(coordinator);
	if (!routes) {
		routes = new Map();
		writeRoutes.set(coordinator, routes);
	}

	let readLocale = '';
	const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime({ scope: 'basic-profile-initial' });
	const detail = useAsamDetail({ runtime, fields: profileFields });
	const model = shallowRef<ProfileRecord | null>(null),
		feedback = ref(''),
		tab = ref('detail');
	let disposed = false,
		generation = 0;
	let editBinding:
		| {
				host: BasicProfileHost;
				request: Omit<ProfileRequest, 'signal'>;
				key: string;
				operationId: string;
		  }
		| undefined;
	const readable = () => !disposed && getHost().allowed && !getHost().disabled;
	const writable = () =>
		readable() && !getHost().readonly && getHost().coordinator === coordinator;
	const key = () => JSON.stringify([identityKey(getHost().context), idKey(getHost().id)]);
	const current = (captured: string, host: BasicProfileHost) =>
		readable() &&
		key() === captured &&
		getHost().services === host.services &&
		getHost().enrich === host.enrich;
	const request = (host: BasicProfileHost, signal: AbortSignal): ProfileRequest => ({
		...host.context,
		id: host.id,
		locale: locale(),
		signal
	});
	function guarded(action: string, write = false) {
		const host = getHost();
		let captured: string;
		try {
			captured = key();
		} catch {
			feedback.value = 'invalidId';
			return false;
		}
		if (!(write ? writable() : readable())) return false;
		host.beforeAction?.(action);
		return current(captured, host) && (!write || writable());
	}
	async function refresh() {
		const token = ++generation;
		model.value = null;
		feedback.value = '';
		if (!guarded('read')) {
			if (token === generation) detail.close();
			return;
		}
		const host = getHost(),
			captured = key();
		let found: ProfileRecord | undefined;
		await detail.open({
			mode: 'load',
			id: host.id,
			load: async (id, context) => {
				if (!current(captured, host) || !runtime.isCurrent(context))
					throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
				const result = await host.services.load({ ...request(host, context.signal), id });
				if (result.status !== 'ready') return result;
				const record = decodeProfile(result.record, id);
				found = decodeProfile(
					host.enrich
						? await host.enrich(record, context, request(host, context.signal))
						: record,
					id
				);

			}
		});

			token === generation &&
			current(captured, host) &&
			detail.status.value === 'ready' &&

			model.value = found;
			readLocale = locale();

	}

		runtime,
		fields: editFields,
		coordinator,
		canWrite: writable,

			if (!binding || !current(binding.key, binding.host) || !writable())
				throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
			const result = await binding.host.services.load({
				...binding.request,
				signal: context.signal
			});
			if (
				!current(binding.key, binding.host) ||
				!runtime.isCurrent(context) ||
				result.status !== 'ready'

		},

			const purpose = payload.purpose;
			return typeof purpose === 'string' && purpose.trim() && purpose.length <= 400

			binding.host.beforeAction?.('save');

				services: binding.host.services,
				request: binding.request
			});

				...binding.request,
				signal: context.signal
			});
			if (
				result.status === 'success' &&
				!receiptMatches(
					result.data,
					{ ...binding.request, signal: context.signal },
					binding.operationId
				)
			)
				return Object.assign(
					createAsamMessageIssue(
						'原操作回执无法匹配，请核实原操作',
						'app.templates.basicProfile.receiptMismatch'
					),
					{ status: 'unknown' as const }
				);
			if (result.status !== 'unknown') originalRoutes.delete(route);
			return result;
		},
		verify: async (operation, context) => {
			const binding = editBinding;
			if (
				!binding ||
				!current(binding.key, binding.host) ||
				!runtime.isCurrent(context) ||
				operation.target.operationId !== binding.operationId
			)
				return { status: 'unknown' };
			const route = routeKey(operation.scope, operation.target.operationId),
				original = originalRoutes.get(route);
			if (!original) return { status: 'unknown' };
			const result = await original.services.verify(operation, {
				...original.request,
				signal: context.signal
			});
			if (
				result.status === 'success' &&
				!receiptMatches(
					result.data,
					{ ...original.request, signal: context.signal },
					binding.operationId
				)
			)
				return { status: 'unknown' };
			if (result.status !== 'unknown') originalRoutes.delete(route);
			return result;
		},
		onSaved: (event) => {
			const binding = editBinding;
			if (
				!binding ||
				!current(binding.key, binding.host) ||
				event.scope !== runtime.scope ||
				!receiptMatches(
					event.result,
					{ ...binding.request, signal: new AbortController().signal },
					binding.operationId
				)
			)
				return;
			binding.host.onSaved?.(event.result);
			if (current(binding.key, binding.host)) void refresh();
		}
	});
	async function edit() {
		if (!model.value || !guarded('edit', true)) return;
		const host = getHost(),
			captured = key(),
			operationId = host.operationId(host.context, host.id);
		if (typeof operationId !== 'string' || !operationId.trim()) {
			feedback.value = 'operationMissing';
			return;
		}
		if (!current(captured, host) || !writable()) return;
		editBinding = {
			host,
			key: captured,
			operationId,
			request: { ...host.context, id: host.id, locale: locale() }
		};
		await editor.open({ mode: 'edit', id: host.id, operationId });
	}
	async function navigate(target: string) {

			);

			!target.startsWith('/') ||
			target.startsWith('//') ||
			target.includes('://') ||
			!allowed.includes(target)
		) {
			feedback.value = 'navigationFailed';
			return false;
		}
		const context = runtime.createContext();
		try {
			const success = await host.navigate(target, request(host, context.signal));
			if (current(captured, host) && runtime.isCurrent(context))

			return success;
		} catch {
			if (current(captured, host)) feedback.value = 'navigationFailed';
			return false;
		} finally {

		}

		[
			() => getHost().context.identity,
			() => getHost().context.scope,
			() => getHost().context.revision,
			() => getHost().id,
			() => getHost().services,
			() => getHost().enrich,
			() => getHost().allowed,
			() => getHost().disabled,
			() => getHost().coordinator
		],
		() => {
			++generation;
			model.value = null;
			tab.value = 'detail';
			editBinding = undefined;
			editor.invalidate();
			detail.close();
			let scope: string;
			try {
				scope = key();
			} catch {
				feedback.value = 'invalidId';
				return;
			}
			if (runtime.scope === scope) runtime.invalidate();
			else runtime.setScope(scope);

		},
		{ immediate: true, flush: 'sync' }
	);

		if (readable() && !editor.visible.value && readLocale !== locale()) void refresh();
	});

		...detail,
		fields: [],
		canRefresh: computed(() => readable() && detail.canRefresh.value),
		refresh
	};
	return {
		detail,
		panel,
		editor,
		model,
		feedback,
		tab,
		readable: computed(readable),
		writable: computed(writable),
		refresh,
		edit,
		navigate,
		returnTarget: computed(() => safeReturn(getHost().returnTo, 'minimal')),
		dispose() {
			if (disposed) return;

			++generation;
			stop();
			stopLocale();
			editor.dispose();
			detail.dispose();
			runtime.invalidate();
			model.value = null;
			editBinding = undefined;
		}
	};
}

import type {
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamSaveResult,
	AsamWriteOperation,
	AsamPendingWrite,
	AsamWriteCoordinator
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { RecordId, ReadIdentity } from '../../details/Types.js';
import type { FlowData } from '../../details/Types.js';
import type { AsamRequestContext } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export type { RecordId, ReadIdentity };
export interface ProfileLine {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly name: string;
	readonly specification: string;
	readonly quantity: number;
	/** CNY分；null表示未提供，不能当作0。 */
	readonly priceCents: number | null;
}
export interface ProfileRecord {
	readonly flow?: FlowData;
	readonly id: RecordId;
	readonly code: string;
	readonly title: string;
	readonly status: string;
	readonly fields: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>;
	readonly lines: readonly ProfileLine[];
	readonly note: string;
	readonly attachments: readonly {
		readonly id: string;
		readonly name: string;
		readonly content: string;
	}[];
	readonly handler: string;
	readonly expected: string;
	readonly history: readonly {
		readonly id: string;
		readonly action: string;
		readonly actor: string;
		readonly time: string;
		readonly opinion?: string;
		readonly result?: string;
	}[];
	readonly related: {
		readonly title: string;
		readonly description: string;
		readonly target: string;
	};
}
export interface ProfileRequest extends ReadIdentity {
	readonly id: RecordId;
	readonly locale: string;
	readonly signal: AbortSignal;
}
export interface ProfileReceipt {
	readonly operationId: string;
	readonly identityKey: string;
	readonly id: RecordId;
}
export interface ProfileServices {
	load(
		input: ProfileRequest
	): Promise<
		| { readonly status: 'ready'; readonly record: ProfileRecord }
		| { readonly status: 'missing' | 'forbidden' }
	>;
	save(
		payload: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>,
		operation: AsamWriteOperation,
		input: ProfileRequest
	): Promise<AsamSaveResult>;
	verify(
		operation: AsamPendingWrite,
		input: ProfileRequest
	): Promise<
		| { readonly status: 'success'; readonly data: ProfileReceipt }
		| { readonly status: 'not-applied' | 'unknown' }
	>;
}
/** 本页局部兼容前端宿主；没有真实审批/采购DTO或网络接口。 */
export interface BasicProfileHost {
	/** 可选内容读取组合；复用当前公开详情请求上下文，不拥有另一套控制器。 */
	readonly enrich?: (
		record: ProfileRecord,
		context: AsamRequestContext,
		request: ProfileRequest
	) => Promise<ProfileRecord>;
	readonly context: ReadIdentity;
	readonly id: RecordId;
	readonly returnTo?: unknown;
	readonly services: ProfileServices;
	readonly coordinator: AsamWriteCoordinator;
	readonly allowed: boolean;
	readonly disabled?: boolean;
	readonly readonly?: boolean;
	readonly operationId: (context: ReadIdentity, id: RecordId) => string;
	readonly onSaved?: (receipt: ProfileReceipt) => void;
	/** 宿主负责目标内容与异步副作用，只接页面登记的本地目标。 */
	readonly navigate: (target: string, input: ProfileRequest) => Promise<boolean>;
	readonly beforeAction?: (action: string) => void;
}

let sequence = 0;
let fallbackPrefix: string | undefined;

/** 模板的操作关联ID和行键；不依赖DOM或安全上下文，也不用于安全凭据。 */
export function createTemplateId(): string {
	const crypto = globalThis.crypto;
	if (typeof crypto?.randomUUID === 'function') return crypto.randomUUID();
	if (typeof crypto?.getRandomValues === 'function') {
		const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
		bytes[6] = (bytes[6]! & 0x0f) | 0x40;
		bytes[8] = (bytes[8]! & 0x3f) | 0x80;
		const hex = [...bytes].map((byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
		return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
	}
	// 无Web Crypto的SSR宿主仍能创建本模块内独立关联键，不在导入时访问浏览器对象。
	fallbackPrefix ??= `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
	return `asam-${fallbackPrefix}-${(++sequence).toString(36)}`;
}

import { computed } from 'vue';
/** 公共输入允许清空或多种标量，页面模型只接收自己声明的合法值。 */
export function choiceModel(read, write, choices) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value) {
			if (choices.some((choice) => Object.is(choice, value))) write(value);
		}
	});
}
export function booleanModel(read, write) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value) {

<script setup>
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
import { computed, useId } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const props = defineProps({
	data: { type: Object, required: false },
	loading: { type: Boolean, required: true },
	error: { type: String, required: true },
	tab: { type: String, required: true },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: true }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['select', 'retry']);
const uid = useId();
function tabAttributes(id) {
	return {
		id: `${uid}-${id}-tab`,
		role: 'tab',
		'aria-selected': props.tab === id,
		'aria-controls': `${uid}-${id}`,
		tabindex: props.tab === id ? 0 : -1
	};
}
const tabs = computed(() => [
	{ id: 'overview', label: i18n.t('app.templates.details.overview') },
	{ id: 'history', label: i18n.t('app.templates.details.flowHistory') },
	{ id: 'related', label: i18n.t('app.templates.details.relatedInformation') }
]);
const stepLabels = computed(() => ({
	done: i18n.t('app.templates.details.complete'),
	current: i18n.t('app.templates.details.inProgress'),
	waiting: i18n.t('app.templates.details.waitingToStart'),
	unknown: i18n.t('app.templates.details.unknownState')
}));
function keyboard(event) {
	if (props.disabled || !['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Home', 'End'].includes(event.key)) return;
	event.preventDefault();
	const index = tabs.value.findIndex((item) => item.id === props.tab);
	const next =
		event.key === 'Home'
			? 0
			: event.key === 'End'
				? 2
				: (index + (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : 2)) % 3;
	const value = tabs.value[next].id;
	emit('select', value);
	if (props.tab === value) document.getElementById(`${uid}-${value}-tab`)?.focus();
	else
		queueMicrotask(() => {
			if (props.tab === value && !props.disabled)
				document.getElementById(`${uid}-${value}-tab`)?.focus();
		});
}
</script>

export const families = ['minimal', 'brand', 'tech'];
export function parseId(type, value) {
	if (
		type === 'number' &&
		typeof value === 'string' &&
		value.trim() !== '' &&
		Number.isFinite(Number(value))

		return Number(value);
	if (type === 'string' && typeof value === 'string' && value !== '') return value;
	throw createAsamMessageError(
		new TypeError('记录 ID 必须是非空字符串或有限数字；拒绝 boolean/null'),
		'app.templates.details.recordIdMustBeANonemptyStringOrFinite'
	);

export function idKey(id) {

		throw createAsamMessageError(

			'app.templates.details.invalidRecordId'

		identity: app.access.identity,
		scope: app.access.scope,
		revision: app.access.revision

}
export function readable(app) {
	return app.access.allowed && !app.access.disabled && app.runtime.scope === app.access.scope;
}
export function gate(app, action) {

	const snapshot = identity(app),
		epoch = app.runtime.epoch,
		services = app.services;

	return (
		readable(app) &&
		services === app.services &&
		epoch === app.runtime.epoch &&
		snapshot.identity === app.access.identity &&
		snapshot.scope === app.access.scope &&
		snapshot.revision === app.access.revision

}
export function remember(app, controller, family) {

	if (!controller.resultReady.value || !intent || !readable(app)) return false;

		services: app.services,

		intent: cloneAsamFieldValue(intent)
	};

}
export function validReturn(app, target) {
	const saved = app.returnState;
	return (
		!!saved &&

export async function restore(app, controller, target) {

	if (!current()) return;
	if (
		controller.intent.value?.pageSize !== saved.intent.pageSize &&
		(await controller.setPageSize(saved.intent.pageSize)).status !== 'success'

		return;
	if (!current()) return;
	if (saved.intent.sort && (await controller.setSort(saved.intent.sort)).status !== 'success')
		return;
	if (!current()) return;
	const last = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(controller.page.data.value.total / saved.intent.pageSize));

import { AsamSteps, AsamStep } from '@asam-ui/ui';

		const width = entries[0]?.contentRect.width;

import { computed, reactive, watch } from 'vue';
import { createBasicProfileFixture } from '../basic/Fixture.js';
import { withAdvancedFlow } from './Flow.js';
/** 本地只读流程adapter，签名沿旧DetailServices.flow；没有审批写入或新业务接口。 */
export function createAdvancedProfileFixture(locale) {
	const base = createBasicProfileFixture();
	const flowControls = reactive({ mode: 'normal' });
	const flowAudit = reactive({ reads: 0, aborted: 0 });
	let disposed = false;
	const pending = new Set();
	const readFlow = async (_id, context, request) => {
		flowAudit.reads++;
		const mode = flowControls.mode,
			english = locale() === 'en';
		const t = (zh, en) => (english ? en : zh);
		await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			let done = false;
			const finish = (aborted) => {
				if (done) return;
				done = true;
				clearTimeout(timer);
				pending.delete(cancel);
				context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
				if (aborted) {
					flowAudit.aborted++;
					reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
				} else resolve();
			};
			const cancel = () => finish(true),
				timer = setTimeout(() => finish(false), base.controls.delayMs);
			pending.add(cancel);
			if (context.signal.aborted || disposed) cancel();
			else context.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
		});
		if (mode === 'error')
			throw Error(
				t('本地流程读取失败，请刷新详情重试', 'Local flow read failed; refresh to retry')
			);
		return {
			stage:
				mode === 'unknown'
					? t('流程状态未知', 'Flow status unknown')
					: t('待部门审批', 'Department approval pending'),
			steps: [
				{
					id: 'submitted',
					name: t('提交申请', 'Application submitted'),
					state: mode === 'unknown' ? 'unknown' : 'done'
				},
				{
					id: 'department',
					name: t('部门审批', 'Department approval'),
					state: mode === 'unknown' ? 'unknown' : 'current'
				},
				{ id: 'purchase', name: t('采购复核', 'Procurement review'), state: 'waiting' },
				{ id: 'inventory', name: t('设备入库', 'Equipment receipt'), state: 'waiting' },
				{ id: 'completed', name: t('完成', 'Completed'), state: 'waiting' }
			],
			records: [
				{
					id: 'submitted',
					actor:
						request.identity === 'reader-a'
							? t('林岚', 'Lin Lan')
							: t('周远', 'Zhou Yuan'),
					at: '2026-10-30T14:30:00Z',
					result: t('已提交本地合成申请', 'Local synthetic application submitted'),
					state: 'recorded'
				},
				{
					id: 'assigned',
					actor: t('审批流程', 'Approval workflow'),
					at: '2026-10-30T14:35:00Z',
					result: t(
						'已分配部门审批，未执行审批写入',
						'Department approval assigned; no approval write performed'
					),
					state: 'recorded'
				}
			],
			related: [
				{
					id: 'project',
					title: t('设备台账体验优化', 'Equipment register improvement'),
					note: t(
						'本地合成关联资料，原始对象保持独立',
						'Local synthetic relation; source objects remain separate'
					)
				}
			]
		};
	};
	const enrich = withAdvancedFlow(base.host.value, readFlow).enrich;
	const host = computed(() => ({ ...base.host.value, enrich }));
	const stop = watch(
		() => flowControls.mode,
		() => {
			base.controls.revision++;
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	return {
		...base,
		host,
		flowControls,
		flowAudit,
		dispose() {
			if (disposed) return;
			disposed = true;
			stop();
			for (const cancel of [...pending]) cancel();
			base.dispose();
		}
	};
}
